storage: Fridge only, in the closed pack or a lidded box lined with a dry paper towel, for 2–3 days. Rinse just before use, not before storing. Do not keep at room temperature: warm, moist sprouts are where bacteria grow (see section 9).
looksLike: Small olive-green whole moong beans that have split open, each with a short white tail (about 0.5–1 cm). Sold chilled in a sealed tray or pouch.
shelfLife: Short: about 2–3 days in the fridge from purchase (follow the pack date). Keep chilled on the way home.

usedIn.raw: about 105 g sprouted (from 40 g dry whole green moong; about 1 cup), boiled about 5 minutes
